question: Does compound X reduce cytokine Y secretion in human monocytes, and is the effect dose-dependent?
answer: Yes. Compound X inhibited cytokine Y secretion by 62% at 10 uM (p=0.003) [biorxiv_10_9999_2026_01_01_000001_v1:b0001]. Monocytes treated with 10 uM compound X secreted 38 pg/mL of cytokine Y versus 100 pg/mL in vehicle controls, and the dose response gave an IC50 of 4.2 uM with no loss of viability up to 30 uM [biorxiv_10_9999_2026_01_01_000001_v1:b0002]. These data support a dose-dependent inhibitory effect, although the mechanism remains unknown [biorxiv_10_9999_2026_01_01_000001_v1:b0003].
limitations: Only one cell type and one cytokine were tested.
The mechanism of inhibition was not established.
